info.description: The clinic platform's API. The clinic comes from the host name.

post.summary:
Books an appointment. Two active bookings can't overlap in one chair (`409`); a doctor
booked in another chair at the same time, on leave, or outside their hours is allowed, with
`warnings`.

400.description: Invalid input; the message names the field

404.description: No such patient in this clinic

patch.summary:
Moves, reassigns or edits an appointment that isn't completed, cancelled or a no-show. Send
the `ETag` you read in `If-Match` to refuse the edit (`412`) if the appointment changed since.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The `row_version` (the `ETag`) you last read, in quotes; the edit is refused with `412` if the record changed since

ETag.description: The `row_version` in quotes; send it back in `If-Match` when editing

400.description: Invalid input; the message names the field

404.description: No such appointment in this clinic

409.description: The appointment is finished, or the chair is taken

412.description: `stale_version`: the record changed since the `If-Match` version; the current version is in `ETag`

post.summary:
Moves an appointment along: booked → confirmed → arrived → in the chair → completed, or
cancelled (with a reason) or no-show before arrival. Arriving issues the branch's next queue
token for the clinic day. Asking for the status it already has changes nothing (no second
history entry or token) and returns the appointment, so a retry after a lost answer is safe.

ETag.description: The `row_version` in quotes; send it back in `If-Match` when editing

400.description: Unknown status, or a cancel without a reason

404.description: No such appointment in this clinic

409.description: A move the table doesn't allow; `current` is the appointment as it is

`doctor`, `online`, `walk_in`, `camp`, `insurance`, `other`, `unknown` (none recorded).
Every kind listed.

visit_kinds.description:
Visits by appointment kind: `new`, `follow_up`, `procedure`, `emergency`. Every kind
listed.

PatientBrief.description: A patient as the calendar and queue show them.

PatientCancelled.description: The appointment's status after a cancellation.

PatientChanges.description:
Changes to a patient. Fields left out stay as they are; an empty `phone`, `email` or
`date_of_birth` clears it.

age_years.description: Age in years when the date of birth is unknown.

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth (`YYYY-MM-DD`), or empty to clear it; give this or `age_years`.

email.description: Email, or empty to clear it; needs `patients.contact`.

phone.description: Phone, or empty to clear it; needs `patients.contact`.

PatientClinic.description: A clinic that linked the patient.

host.description: Its portal host: bookings, cancellations and files go there.

linked_at.description: When the clinic linked the patient (RFC 3339).

patient_number.description: The patient's number at this clinic, such as `SD-1042`.

timezone.description: IANA time zone; times from this clinic are in it.

PatientClinicSummary.description: The home screen for one clinic.

balance_paise.description: Owed on issued bills, in paise.

oneOf.description: The next appointment that isn't cancelled or over.

PatientFile.description: A file a clinic shared with the patient.

clinic_id.description: The clinic: fetch it from that clinic's host.

PatientFiles.description: Files the clinics shared with the patient.

PatientHome.description: Everything the home screen needs, in one request.

email.description: The verified email they signed in with.

oneOf.description: The soonest upcoming appointment at any clinic.

PatientIdentifier.description: Another number a patient is known by.

csv.description: The CSV text, header line first; at most 5,000 rows and 2 MB.

mapping.description:
Our field to the file's column header (matched ignoring case). Fields: `full_name`
(required), `sex`, `date_of_birth`, `age_years`, `phone`, `email`,
`preferred_language`, `file_number`, `legacy_id`.

mode.description: `preview` checks every row and saves nothing; `commit` saves the valid rows.

PatientLinkDecided.description: A link's status after the clinic's decision.

PatientMe.description: The signed-in patient and the clinics that linked them.

email.description: The verified email they signed in with.

PatientMessage.description: What happened to the patient's copy.

expires_at.description: When the emailed link stops working. Only when sent.

pin.description: The six-digit PIN to tell the patient; shown once, never in the email. Only when sent.

reason.description: Why nothing was sent: `declined`, `no_email` (give the printed copy) or `no_portal`.

PatientMix.description: New and returning patients in a period.

new.description: Patients whose first visit ever was in this period.

returning.description: Patients seen who had visited before this period.

oneOf.description: The summary note; absent until someone writes it.

visit_notes.description: Visit notes, newest first (up to 100), limited to those the caller's role reaches.

PatientPrescription.description: One of the patient's issued prescriptions.

issued_at.description: When it was issued (RFC 3339, the clinic's time zone).

verify_url.description: The public page that verifies it (its QR code), on the clinic's host.

PatientRef.description: A patient as a bill or payment names them.

Payment.description: A payment and its receipt number.

PendingItem.description: An issued bill with something left to pay.

outstanding_paise.description: Left to pay on all of them, in paise.

PhoneLookup.description: A phone to look up. Sent in the body, never the URL.

phone.description: The phone in any common Indian format; +91 is assumed without a country code.

PhoneMatch.description: A registered patient with that phone: just enough to say "this is them".

items.description: Matches by name; at most 10. Families share numbers, so there may be several.

alt.description: What it shows; empty removes it.

PhotoForm.description: The form a picture upload sends (`multipart/form-data`).

alt.description: What it shows, for people who cannot see it.

file.description: The picture: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB. Its type is read from its content.

Plan.description: A treatment plan with its estimate.

estimate_paise.description: The sum of the items that aren't cancelled, in paise.

visit_id.description: The visit it was proposed in.

PlanItem.description: A step of a treatment plan.

PlanList.description: A patient's treatment plans, newest first.

membership_id.description: Their membership, if they sign in.

qualifications.description: Qualifications printed on the letterhead, such as `BDS, MDS`.

PractitionerBrief.description: A doctor as the calendar shows them.

PractitionerFields.description:
A doctor to add, or changes to one. Fields left out stay as they are; an empty
`membership_id`, `registration_number`, `qualifications` or `specialty` clears it.

active.description: Whether they can be booked (default true).

display_name.description: Name shown on the calendar, 1 to 120 characters; required when adding.

membership_id.description: The member who is this doctor.

code.description: Short code, unique in the clinic.

sac_hsn.description: SAC (9993 for health care) or HSN code.

taxable.description: Whether GST applies. Health care by a clinical establishment is exempt.

PriceItemValues.description:
A price list entry's values. On a change, fields left out stay as they are and an empty
string clears an optional one.

category.description: Revenue-mix category: lower case, digits and `_`.

name.description: Name; required for a new entry.

price_paise.description: Default price in paise; required for a new entry.

taxable.description:
Whether GST applies (medicines and products); false (exempt) by default unless a rate
is given.

PrintData.description: What the paper shows besides the medicines.

brand_line.description: `Prescribed with Aarogyam`, printed beside the QR code.

doctor.description: Doctor's name and registration number (null when not recorded).

letterhead.description: Clinic name, legal name, address, phone, brand colour.

patient.description: Patient's name, number, age and sex at issue.

verify_path.description:
Path the QR code opens on the clinic's host: the portal's public verify page,
`/verify/prescriptions/{token}` (which reads `GET /api/v1/verify/prescriptions/{token}`).

Procedure.description:
A procedure planned or done in a visit. Done procedures never change; a mistaken one is
marked `entered_in_error` with a reason.

error_reason.description: Why it was marked entered in error.

plan_item_id.description: The treatment plan item it carries out.

QualityFailingTest.description: A test failing in the newest run that recorded it.

QualityFailure.description: One test that failed within a suite.

message.description: Why it failed. Never patient data.

test.description: The test's name, as its runner reports it.

failing.description: Tests failing in the newest run.

commit.description: The git commit the suites ran at.

run_id.description: Identifies the run; also its file name's stem.

QualitySuite.description: One suite's result within a run.

name.description: The suite's name, such as `aarogyam-dal (db)` or `portal e2e`.

QualityTrend.description: A suite's pass-rate history across the returned runs, oldest first.

QualityTrendPoint.description: A point on a suite's pass-rate trend.

pass_rate.description: Passed over (passed + failed); `1.0` when nothing was graded.

appointment_id.description: The appointment; none for a walk-in.

called_at.description: When the patient was called in (RFC 3339).

done_at.description: When they were done or left (RFC 3339).

token_number.description: Number shown on the screen; restarts at 1 each day per branch.

wait_minutes.description: Minutes waited: until now while waiting, otherwise until called.

QuickMedicineSet.description: Several medicines added in one tap, each still editable; the allergy check still runs on issue.

QuickPick.description: A pick that is only a name: an allergy substance or a procedure.

label.description: What staff read and what is recorded.

allergies.description: Common allergy substances, offered at a walk-in.

complaints.description: Chief complaints: each writes the note's opening line.

QuickSetMedicine.description: One medicine of a set, as a prescription line starts.

drug_name.description: Generic name; match it to the medicine list before adding.

QuickTextPick.description: A pick that writes a line: a complaint, a finding or an advice line.

Reason.description: A reason, for voiding or cancelling.

expiry.description: Last day it may be used, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

received_on.description: Day it arrived, `YYYY-MM-DD`; today by default.

unit_cost_paise.description: Cost of one unit in paise; 0 by default.

given_at.description: When the patient agreed (RFC 3339); now when absent. Not in the future.

note.description: A short remark, up to 500 characters. No clinical detail.

notice_version.description: The clinic's label for the notice text shown, 1 to 40 characters, such as `v1 2026-10`.

RedeemHandoff.description: A code to redeem on the host it was made for.

code.description: The code from the URL fragment.

RedeemLinkCode.description: A link code from the clinic.

code.description: The code, such as `7KQ2M-X9D4T` (case, spaces and dashes don't matter).

RegistrationReceived.description: The one answer to a valid application.

RejectApplication.description: Why an application is turned down.

reason.description: A short reason, for the console only.

ResentOwnerInvitation.description:
An owner invitation sent again. `invite_link` is shown once; it was also emailed, and the
previous link no longer works.

invite_link.description: The invitation link, with its new one-time secret.

is_template.description: Whether it is one of the standard roles.

member_count.description: Members who have it (invited, active or suspended).

RoleChange.description: A change to a role's access.

default_permissions.description: What "reset to default" restores; empty without a template.

editable.description: Whether it can be changed: every role but the owner.

history.description: The latest changes, newest first (at most 10).

is_template.description: Whether it is one of the standard roles.

member_count.description: Members who have it (invited, active or suspended).

permissions.description: What it may do, sorted by key.

template_key.description: The standard role its defaults come from; its own key for a standard role.

scope.description:
`all`, `own` or `assigned`; only scopes the catalogue lists for the permission.
Default `all`.

RolePermissionsUpdate.description: A role's complete new permission list. Anything left out is taken away.

permissions.description: Every permission the role will have, each once.

RoleTemplate.description: A standard role and the permissions it starts with.

permissions.description: Its default permissions, sorted by key.

items.description: Standard roles first, then by name.

RoomFields.description: A room to add, or changes to one. Fields left out stay as they are (or take the default).

active.description: Whether it can be booked (default true).

branch_id.description: Branch; the default branch when adding without one.

name.description: Name, 1 to 60 characters; required when adding.

choice.description:
`skip` (leave it out), `merge` (fill the matching record's empty details) or `import`
(a different person).

drug_id.description: The catalogue entry; its values fill what is left out.

drug_name.description: As printed, generic name in capitals; required for free text.

RxValues.description:
A draft's values. On an edit, fields left out stay, an empty string clears text,
`encounter_id` or `follow_up_on`, and `items` replaces every medicine.

language.description: Language, such as `hi-IN`; the patient's by default.

SavedAppointment.description: An appointment after a booking or change.

warnings.description: Warnings; empty when all is well.

SavedRole.description: A role after its permissions were set.

changed.description: Whether anything changed; an unchanged list records nothing.

is_template.description: Whether it is one of the standard roles.

permissions.description: What it may do now, sorted by key.

SearchRequest.description: What to search for. Sent in the body, never the URL: search terms are names and phone numbers.

new_this_month.description: Only patients registered this month, in the clinic's time zone.

q.description:
A number (`SD-1042` or `1042`), a phone number, or the start of a name. Empty lists
the most recently registered patients.

recalls_due.description: Only patients with an open recall due on or before today.

with_balance.description: Only patients with a balance on issued bills (needs `billing.read`).

ServiceMetrics.description: Service health for the console dashboard.

api.description: This instance's API requests, error rates and latency.

db.description: Database connections, cache hit ratio, size, tables and slow statements.

edge.description: Edge and front-end numbers from Cloudflare; `null` until connected.

SessionClinic.description: The clinic the portal runs in.

SessionMembership.description: The member's place in the clinic.

permissions.description: Permission keys the role holds, such as `patients.read`.

practice.description: `solo`, `team` or `multi`, once the owner said (the clinic's setup only).

key.description:
The step key: `clinic`, `hours`, `look`, `services` or `team` (the owner's), `profile`
(a doctor's own).

status.description: `done`, `skipped`, or `todo` while the person hasn't answered.

SetupUpdate.description: An answer to one step, and other changes. Anything left out stays as it is.

dismissed.description: Close (`true`) or reopen (`false`) the "Finish setting up" card.

ShareLink.description: A new patient link. The token and PIN are shown once.

pin.description: Six-digit PIN to print on the paper or tell the patient.

token.description: Token for the link: `/shared/{token}` on the clinic's host.

SharedPreview.description: What a link shows before its PIN: no patient data.

body.description: A few paragraphs, separated by blank lines.

SiteChoice.description: A doctor or service the owner may show or hide.

SiteClinic.description: Who the clinic is and how to reach it.

brand.description: The clinic's brand colour, `#RRGGBB`, if set.

SiteContact.description: Contact details beyond the branch's phone and address.

hours_note.description: A note under the opening hours.

map_url.description: A `https://` link to the clinic on a map.

whatsapp.description: `WhatsApp` number; +91 is assumed without a country code.

SiteDoctorProfile.description: What the owner adds to a doctor the clinic already has.

hidden.description: Leave the doctor off the website.

photo_id.description: A doctor portrait uploaded to the website.

SiteDomain.description: Where the clinic's own domain verification stands, with what to show the owner.

address_status.description:
Whether the edge serves that address yet: `none` (not published), `pending`, `ready`
or `failed`. A published site is reachable within about two minutes.

custom_domain.description: The clinic's own domain, if any.

default_address.description: The free address the site is served on without a domain of the clinic's own.

sites_target.description: What a `www` CNAME record points to.

verification_token.description: The value of the TXT record that proves ownership.

SiteHero.description: The top of the home page.

SitePage.description: What a clinic website shows, and only that: no patient data, no registration numbers.

hero.description: The top of the home page.

hours.description: Opening hours; days without hours are left out.

reviews.description: Reviews the clinic chose to show.

seo.description: Search engine text; empty parts are filled by the page.

url.description: Where to load it from, on the clinic's host.

SiteReview.description: A review the clinic chose to show.

fee_paise.description: Fee in paise; absent when the clinic hides fees.

hidden.description: Price list entries left off the website.

SiteTemplate.description: A design the owner may choose.

palettes.description: Its palettes; the first is the default.

SlugCheck.description: Whether an address is free, with free alternatives when it isn't.

available.description: Free to use now (creating the clinic still checks).

problem.description: Why it can't be used, when malformed or reserved.

errors.description: Why it can't be imported or was skipped, as `field: problem`. Never echoes values.

missing.description:
Details missing from a new patient (`phone`, `sex`, `date_of_birth`): they go on the
front desk's to-do list.

patient_id.description: The patient it became or was merged into, on commit.

values.description:
Preview only: the values as they will be saved, by field (contact details hidden
without `patients.contact`).

warnings.description: Values left empty because they couldn't be read, as `field: problem`.

invitations.description: Invitations neither accepted nor expired, newest first.

members.description: Members, active first, then by name.

StartedVisit.description: A visit started from the queue.

created.description: Whether this request started the visit; false on a repeat.

token.description: The token, now in the chair.

visit.description: The visit: new, or the one the token or its appointment already had.

reason.description: Why; required to cancel, up to 200 characters.

StatusChanged.description: An appointment after a status change.

queue_token_id.description: Its queue token, once the patient has arrived.

expiry.description: Last day it may be used, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

unit_cost_paise.description: Cost of one unit in paise.

StockChangeResponse.description: The result of a delivery, use or correction.

movements.description: What was recorded, one movement per batch touched.

stock.description: The item as it stands now.

StockCountsResponse.description: Items by status, for the summary cards.

expiring.description: Items with a batch expiring within 30 days.

low.description: Items at or below the reorder level.

StockLevel.description: An item and where its stock stands.

next_expiry.description: Earliest expiry among batches with stock left, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

status.description:
`ok`, `low` (at or below the reorder level), `critical` (out, or at a fifth of the
reorder level or less) or `expiring` (enough, but a batch expires within 30 days).

quantity.description: Signed units: negative took stock off the shelf.

items.description: Every item, critical first, then low, expiring and ok; each group by name.

body.description:
The text, up to 20,000 characters, in the Markdown subset. Empty clears the note. HTML,
links, images and code are refused (`400`).

SummaryNote.description: A patient's summary note: formatted text kept up to date outside any single visit.

body.description:
The text: a strict Markdown subset (headings `#` to `###`, `-` and `1.` lists, `**bold**`,
`*italic*`). Render it with a renderer that treats everything else as plain text.

row_version.description: Goes up when the text changes. Send it back in `If-Match` (it is also the `ETag`).

SupplierValues.description:
A supplier's values. On a change, fields left out stay as they are and an empty string
clears an optional one.

name.description: Name; required for a new supplier.

phone.description: Phone; +91 is assumed without a country code.

appointments.description: Appointments today, not counting cancelled ones.

member_id.description:
The staff membership this doctor's profile belongs to, when linked. A staff list shown
beside the team uses it to show each person once.

Timeline.description: A page of a patient's timeline, newest first.

TimelineEvent.description: One event on a patient's timeline.

amount_paise.description: The fee in paise, for procedures.

at.description: When it happened (RFC 3339): a visit's start, a note's signing, a procedure's doing.

detail.description: More detail: the chief complaint, the assessment, the tooth or the caption.

id.description: The record: open it through its own route.

title.description: A short title: the visit number, the note kind, the procedure name or the file kind.

booked.description: Booked or confirmed, not arrived yet.

total.description: Appointments today, not counting cancelled ones.

collected_paise.description: Received today, in paise (the revenue tile).

pending.description: The five largest balances, for the pending payments table.

pending_dues_paise.description: Left to pay on every issued bill (the pending dues tile).

revenue_mix.description: This month's revenue mix, for the donut.

upi_share_bps.description: UPI's share of this month's collections, in basis points.

TodayResponse.description: Today at the clinic. Money tiles arrive with billing.

appointments.description: Today's appointments by start, cancelled ones included.

as_of.description: When this was built (RFC 3339); waits are measured from here.

attention.description: Late arrivals and long waits, longest first.

by_hour.description: Appointments per local hour, for hours that have any.

chairs.description: Each active chair: who is in it and who is next.

low_stock.description:
Stock at or below its reorder level, worst first. Present only for roles with
`inventory.read`.

recent_patients.description: The latest patients through the queue today, newest first.

unread.description: Unread notifications from the last 30 days, at most 100; show "99+" above 99.

addendum_id.description: The uploader's addendum to a signed note, which the recording belongs to.

duration_seconds.description: A recording's length in seconds, 1 to 600; required for audio.

file.description:
The file: JPEG, PNG, PDF, DICOM or a `WebM`, `MP4` or `Ogg` recording, up to 10 MB. Its type is
read from its content.

id.description: A version 7 UUID the client made. A retry with the same `id` and the same content returns the record that exists instead of making another; `id_conflict` (`409`) when the id belongs to a different record. The server makes one when left out.

label.description: A label, 1 to 60 characters: `OPG`, `Intraoral - upper`, `X-ray`, `Consent` or your own.

note_id.description: A recording's note (a draft of the uploader, or a signed note together with `addendum_id`).

tooth.description: FDI number of the tooth it shows.

reason.description: Why or for whom, without patient details.

Verification.description: What the QR code shows: never patient data.

issued_on.description: The clinic day it was issued.

appointment_id.description: The appointment it was started from.

chart_entries.description: Dental chart entries recorded in the visit.

notes.description: Notes with their addenda, oldest first.

observations.description: Vital signs recorded in the visit, oldest first; corrected values stay, marked by status.

procedures.description: Procedures planned or done in the visit.

VisitNote.description: A visit note as listed on the patient. Open the visit to edit it or add an addendum.

row_version.description: The note's version; send it in `If-Match` to `PATCH /notes/{id}` (drafts only).

consents_recorded.description: The purposes whose consent was recorded.

registered.description: Whether the patient was registered by this request.

branch_id.description: Branch; the default branch when left out.

patient_id.description: The patient (register them first if new).

WalkInRequest.description:
A walk-in: a new patient (`patient`) or a registered one (`patient_id`), exactly one of the
two.

allergies.description:
Substances the patient says they are allergic to, each 1 to 200 characters (at most
20). Recorded as patient-reported until a clinician confirms them; ones already on record
are not repeated.

branch_id.description: Branch; the default branch when left out.

consents.description:
Consents given at the desk, each purpose once. Purposes already in force are left as
they are.

no_known_allergies.description: The patient knows of no allergies. Not together with `allergies`.

notice_version.description: The notice version shown; the clinic's current notice (`v1 2026-10`) when left out.

oneOf.description: Details of a patient to register now.

patient_id.description: A registered patient, such as one picked from the phone lookup.

practitioner_id.description: The doctor, if known. A member who sees only their own patients must name themselves.

WebsiteChanges.description: Changes to the website; anything left out stays as it is.

oneOf.description: All the content; replaces what is stored.

custom_domain.description: The clinic's own domain; an empty string removes it. A new domain starts as `pending`.

published.description: Publish or take the site down.

template.description: The design. A new design starts with its first palette unless `palette` is given.

WebsiteContent.description: Everything the owner writes. Every part is optional.

hero.description: The top of the home page.

WebsiteSettings.description: The owner's website settings and everything the editor needs.

doctors.description: Doctors the owner may show or hide.

preview.description: The site as it shows now, published or not.

services.description: Services the owner may show or hide.

note.description: A short remark, up to 500 characters.

name.description: What is done, 1 to 200 characters, such as "Composite filling".

tooth.description: FDI tooth number: 11-48, or 51-85 for primary teeth.

shifts.description: Shifts by weekday and start; split shifts are two entries.
